title: Chapter 29: Interception And Suppression
content:
Chapter 29: Interception And Suppression

The pursuit troops of the bear goblin tribe advanced rapidly, chasing along the escape route of the fleeing crowd.

This was a route carefully selected by Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects.

The terrain along the way forced the pursuit troops to lengthen the marching team. The army of 5,000 people slowly turned into a long dragon, forming a long snake formation.

"Send more scouts out, be careful of the enemy's ambush!"

The knight ordered more scouts to scout the surrounding situation again.

All the scouts sent out reported that everything was normal. Except for the fleeing crowd, no other enemies were found.

This made him feel a little relieved, but he always felt something was wrong.

"Where did the two missing lizardmen troops go?"

He had never figured out this question.

When the entire pursuit troops' long snake formation entered a terrain position that was very unsuitable for the deployment of the team, countless enemies suddenly appeared around the front half of the team, quickly cutting the entire team into two sections.

The long snake formation was split into two, and the lizardmen and some bear goblins who were leading the way in front of the team suffered fierce attacks.

This was the Zerg army that Wu Qing had ambushed here in advance.

400 hydralisks occupied the absolutely advantageous high ground and launched a long-range attack on the enemy.

More than 1,000 puppies were responsible for cutting the pursuit troops of the bear goblins into two sections and besieging the front part with all their strength.

Due to the favorable terrain, the soldiers in the back half of the pursuit troops could not launch an effective attack. Only a small number of puppies were needed to block the middle section of the long snake formation to cut off the connection between the front and back of the enemy troops.

The thorns of the 400 hydralisks spewed rapidly and fiercely, causing huge casualties to the lizardmen soldiers.

These lizardmen soldiers did not have the strong body and heavy defense of the bear goblins. They were just a kind of light infantry that was stronger than the unarmored militia. Facing the attack of the hydralisk, they were simply unable to resist.

In the current battlefield, they could not form a large defense formation and could only rely on their own strength to bear it.

Most of the soldiers who were blocked by the Zerg were lizardmen. They were dying at a very fast speed and disappeared in light.

The tall bear goblin knight felt a dilemma when he saw this situation.

If he wanted to retreat and abandon the troops in front, he would have to retreat a long distance to reach a better terrain.

If he advanced, he would be restricted and the troops would not be able to move at all.

He dared to pursue in such a terrain because he had confidence in his own scouts. He did not expect that the enemy in front of him could not be guessed according to common sense.

"You can hide underground without any flaws!"

"You can sacrifice at any time on the battlefield!"

"This should be a believer of a powerful alien god!"

He had a qualitative understanding of the Zerg and immediately made a decision. For the believers of the alien god, they must not be let go.

"God of the Spirit!"

"The enemies are all pagans who believe in alien gods! Now is the time for us to sacrifice ourselves for the spiritual god!"

"All troops attack!"

The knight shouted and ordered the entire army to attack!

"Attack!"

"All troops attack!"

All the bear goblin soldiers suddenly erupted, launching a suicidal attack on the blocking puppies regardless of casualties.

The army of the bear goblin tribe could not move freely. In addition to the long-range attacking hydralisks of the Zerg army, which occupied the advantageous terrain in advance, the melee puppies were also unable to move freely.

The Zerg has a strong ability to adapt to terrain. They can climb rocks and cross ditches. Ordinary obstacles cannot stop their attack at all, so they can calmly choose the number of puppies to be put into battle.

It's just that Wu Qing didn't want the puppies to be consumed too quickly, and he had to buy time for the gathering of the puppies behind. Therefore, he only defended the rear section of the pursuit troops and did not actively attack.

Leaving the advantage unused is equivalent to blocking one's own hands and feet.

The two sides just kept fighting in a limited space, fighting for consumption.

The middle position between the front and back parts of the battlefield has now become a meat grinder. Both sides continue to invest troops and fight a bloody battle here.

Every moment, the bear goblin soldiers and the Zerg puppies fell down, and were then trampled by the later ones and died miserably.

Fortunately, the bodies of both sides will disappear in light due to the system, otherwise this place would have become a sea of corpses and blood.

Under the attack of the bear goblin soldiers regardless of consumption, the Zerg's troops could not keep up.

Wu Qing transferred all the puppies gathered not far away to join the battle and fight with the bear goblin army here.

One less enemy died, and it didn't matter if the puppies died. The resources provided by the enemies they killed would allow them to be reborn.

Only by consuming in this way, when the Zerg is still weak, there is a chance to defeat a strong enemy.

The army of the bear goblin tribe here can easily break through a territory with more than 100,000 people. Its number and strength are unmatched by the Zerg.

As long as the enemy is not given a chance and the Zerg territory is found for a decisive battle, the rapidly developing Zerg has a chance to defeat such a strong enemy.

There should be many territories of native races around now. Wu Qing plans to find them all and help them well, so that they can attract the enemy's attention.

Zerg's puppies began to be continuously thrown into the battlefield, accelerating the demise of the Lizardmen.

The Lizardmen troops could not break through, and both the Bugbears and the Zerg had reasons not to retreat. It was like pig iron hitting pig iron, sparks all over the ground.

The battle that followed was the same old routine, without much technical content. The Zerg's puppies kept coming out, coming up, and dying until the enemy was exhausted.

Wu Qing also reserved enough puppies outside the battlefield. At the beginning of the ambush, he killed all the enemy's scouts outside and cut off the connection between this unit and the city behind.

He didn't know whether the enemy had means of long-distance communication. He hadn't found it yet. Regardless of whether there was, the necessary preventive work had to be done.

The fleeing crowd who heard the fighting behind them sped up their journey.

Before they were accepted by other territories, they could only be regarded as refugees.

This ambush lasted a little long because of the terrain restrictions and Wu Qing's deliberate delay.

It took a lot of time for the puppies to run from the Zerg territory to here. The longer the fight lasted, the more advantageous it was for Wu Qing.

It also bought more time for the refugees to travel.

The city behind did not receive the news sent back by the pursuit troops, and sent scouts to inquire, but they were all ambushed by the puppies.

The scouts sent out did not return, so something must have gone wrong. Because the situation was unclear, the city did not send out reinforcements.

After a big battle, the local race camp might gather its forces and ambush them.

Now everything should be stable, and other things should be considered after stabilization.

This situation gave Wu Qing the opportunity to calmly deal with the pursuit troops.

The long fight is finally coming to an end, and the Zerg has to face the strong.

This time there is only one one-star strongman, the knight who leads this pursuit force. He personally led the last cavalry and launched a desperate charge against the Zerg.

The puppies did not hold back, flying over the eaves and walls, and surrounded the charging cavalry from all directions.

The terrifying black insect tide rushed over and buried everything!

The insect tide surged, and after a moment, it returned to calm.

All enemies under the insect tide disappeared.

Killed a total of 3/10 one-star creatures.
